exposure: birth at a level II hospital
high Clinical Risk Index for Babies score
cohort: Infants born before 27 weeks of gestation in Sweden from 2004-2007
finding: Several obstetric factors, including mode of delivery, influenced the risk of death within the first day of life for extremely preterm infants, but not later; antenatal corticosteroids and gestational age decreased mortality up to 1 year, and mental developmental delay was related to vaginal breech delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section decreased the risk of death within 24 hours of birth, while vaginal breech delivery increased both the risk of death within 24 hours and the risk of mental developmental delay at 2.5 years.
